items.originalTitle: Nico Rosberg compares Ferrari’s clashes to his own Mercedes F1 rivalry: “The instructions are not clear enough”
items.summaryEn: Nico Rosberg compared the clashes between Ferrari drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc to his own rivalry with Hamilton at Mercedes, saying Ferrari's team instructions are not clear enough.
detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格将法拉利的内斗与自己当年在梅赛德斯的一级方程式竞争相比较：“指令不够明确”。
这位2016年世界冠军就刘易斯·汉密尔顿与夏尔·勒克莱尔近期的碰撞发表看法。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利。
尼科·罗斯伯格对在同队的一级方程式赛车里与刘易斯·汉密尔顿轮对轮较量颇有心得。
两人曾在梅赛德斯车队做过四年队友，竞争激烈；如今汉密尔顿效力法拉利，与夏尔·勒克莱尔并肩作战，期间因车队指令分歧和赛道上的冲突，关系有时变得紧张。
在蒙扎，汉密尔顿起步后冲进砂石区；而在墨西哥站第一圈，两人在争夺领先位置时双双冲出赛道，为马克斯·维斯塔潘从法拉利车队手中抢走胜利铺平了道路。
尽管车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔严厉表达了自己的不满，但罗斯伯格并不认为法拉利车队处理这个问题处理得特别好。
谈到2016年摩纳哥大奖赛时，他让争冠对手汉密尔顿超过自己去追赶丹尼尔·里卡多争夺胜利，罗斯伯格解释说，梅赛德斯为队友之间更健康的合作营造了合适的条件。
“这很容易，因为托托[沃尔夫]和车队在明确车队比赛准则方面做得非常好，”这位2016年世界冠军对《Beyond The Grid》播客表示。“这很清楚：如果车队有可能失去比赛胜利，那么到了你需要作为团队驾驶、而不再作为冠军竞争对手驾驶的时刻。这非常清楚。
“在摩纳哥，我跑得不好，因为我的护目镜起雾太严重，我看不清前进方向。我非常慢，里卡多正在远处消失，所以很明显存在我们在这里失去胜利的威胁。所以很清楚，那时你需要作为团队驾驶，刘易斯需要有机会，所以挥手让他过去。
尼科·罗斯伯格，梅赛德斯AMG F1 W07 Hybrid
“那非常痛苦，但如果指令事先明确，就没那么糟，这非常重要，指令要事先明确，而这正是法拉利例如目前在F1做得不够好的地方，因为指令不够明确，然后你就会遇到车手之间的这种争吵。只需要明确就行。
“而且，当时我们也没有做到完美。这次我们做到了，但我们没做到完美的地方是轮对轮缠斗。关于轮对轮缠斗，你永远无法把细节讲得足够清楚，以便在何时明确谁该负责，而我们当时没有讲得足够细。
“我们尝试过，我们在印制自己的轮对轮缠斗规则手册方面已经相当超前，但还不够详细，而且总是存在模糊之处，每一次都是如此——也因为刘易斯在轮对轮比赛中实在太聪明了，所以从来不是100%他的错，有时会是100%我的错。”
撇开他们‘仅仅’把对方挤出赛道的情况不谈，汉密尔顿和罗斯伯格在车队期间实际上有三次相撞——2014年比利时大奖赛以及2016年西班牙和奥地利大奖赛。那两次他们都与胜利无缘。
梅赛德斯最终确实实施了一条简单的规则来阻止他们不必要地相撞：他们必须分担银箭赛车之间任何碰撞的费用——罗斯伯格说有一次这让他损失了36万美元。
这位德国人解释说，梅赛德斯F1非执行主席尼基·劳达在维持他与汉密尔顿之间一定程度的和谐方面发挥了重要作用。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿驾驶的梅赛德斯AMG F1 W07 Hybrid与尼科·罗斯伯格驾驶的梅赛德斯AMG F1 W07 Hybrid在开场圈发生碰撞。
“帕迪（洛，执行总监）是个厌恶风险的人，”罗斯伯格详细说道。“他作为一个人试图避免对抗，所以让他来主持这样的事后讨论并不理想，因为他往往会选择最容易的路径——而不是像那样妥善处理、直面我们，他会选择阻力最小的路径，这并不理想。
“当托托和尼基介入时情况就好多了。尼基介入过好几次；他是一位出色的调解人，因为我们都敬重他。
“他非常擅长让我们每个人都至少承担一点责任，这让我们走得更近了。当事情不完全是另一个人的错时，尼基会让我们俩都说，‘好吧，那部分我同意，也许我关门的时机有点太晚了’。然后刘易斯会说，‘是的，我同意，我在草地上太激进了’，或者类似的话。
“那种做法开始让我们走到一起，也让我们能够坐下来一起说，‘好吧，让我们试着把这件事翻篇吧’。”
detailEn: Nico Rosberg compares Ferrari’s clashes to his own Mercedes F1 rivalry: “The instructions are not clear enough”
The 2016 world champion weighs in on Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc’s recent collisions
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Nico Rosberg knows a thing or two about racing Lewis Hamilton wheel to wheel in sister Formula 1 cars.

The pair were team-mates for four years at Mercedes with an intense rivalry, and now Hamilton competes for Ferrari alongside Charles Leclerc – which has become tense at times, amid disagreements over team orders and on-track clashes.

Hamilton ended up in the gravel at the start in Monza, while on lap one in Mexico they both went off the track while battling for the lead, paving the way for Max Verstappen to snatch victory away from the Scuderia.
While team principal Fred Vasseur sternly expressed his frustration, Rosberg doesn’t reckon the Scuderia has been handling the issue particularly well.

Speaking about the 2016 Monaco Grand Prix, when he let title rival Hamilton through to chase Daniel Ricciardo for victory, Rosberg explained Mercedes had instilled the right conditions for healthier cooperation between team-mates.

“It was very easy, because Toto [Wolff] and the team did a very good job clarifying the team racing guidelines,” the 2016 world champion told the Beyond The Grid podcast. “It’s very clear: if the team is looking to lose the race win, then the moment comes when you need to drive as a team and not anymore as championship rivals. It was very clear.

“In Monaco, I was not going well because my visor was so fogged up I couldn’t see where I was going. I was very slow, Ricciardo was disappearing in the distance, so it was very clear there was a threat that we’re losing the win here. So it’s very clear then you need to drive as a team and Lewis needs to have a shot at it, so wave him past.
Nico Rosberg, Mercedes AMG F1 W07 Hybrid

“That was super painful, but it’s not so bad when the instructions are clear beforehand, and that’s so important, that the instructions are clear beforehand, which is something that Ferrari for example is not doing well enough at the moment in F1, because the instructions are not clear enough, and then you get this arguing between the drivers. It just needs to be clear.

“Also, we didn’t do it perfectly at the time either. We did in this case, but what we didn’t do perfectly was wheel-to-wheel battles. You can never be enough into details as to wheel-to-wheel battles to make it very clear who’s at fault when, and we didn’t go into details enough.

“We tried, we were quite well advanced in printing our own rulebook for wheel-to-wheel battles, but it was not detailed enough, and there was always ambiguity, every single time – also because Lewis is so damn smart in wheel-to-wheel racing, so it was never 100% his fault, and sometimes it would be 100% my fault.”

Discounting instances where they ‘merely’ pushed each other off the track, Hamilton and Rosberg actually collided on three occasions during their time at the team – the 2014 Belgian GP and the 2016 Spanish and Austrian GP. Victory eluded them twice then.

Mercedes did eventually implement a simple rule to deter them from unnecessarily clashing: they would have to share the cost of any collision between the Silver Arrows – which Rosberg says cost him $360,000 on one occasion.
The German explained Mercedes F1 non-executive chairman Niki Lauda had played a big role in maintaining a level of harmony between him and Hamilton.
Lewis Hamilton, Mercedes AMG F1 W07 Hybrid and Nico Rosberg, Mercedes AMG F1 W07 Hybrid collide on the opening lap

“Paddy [Lowe, executive director] is a risk-averse person,” Rosberg detailed. “He tries to avoid confrontation as a human, so not ideal to have him managing such a post-incident discussion, because he would take, very often, the easiest path – not like go into it properly, confronting us, he would choose the path of least resistance, which is not ideal.
“It was better when Toto and Niki got involved. Niki got involved quite a few times; he was a great mediator, because we all appreciated him.

“He was very good at getting each of us to own a little bit of it at least, and that brought us closer. When it wasn’t just 100% the other guy’s fault, Niki would get both of us to [say], ‘Yeah OK, that part I agree, maybe that was a bit too late that I closed the door’. And then Lewis would say, ‘Yeah, I agree, I went too crazy aggressive on the grass’, or whatever.
“That kind of started to move us together and to a way that we could then sit us together and say, ‘OK, let’s try and move on from this’.”
keyPointsZh: 罗斯伯格是2016年世界冠军，曾与汉密尔顿在梅赛德斯做队友四年。
他就汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔近期的碰撞发表了看法。

He weighed in on the recent collisions between Hamilton and Leclerc.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔：梅赛德斯车手因更换引擎，将在圣保罗大奖赛被罚退后五位发车
天空体育F1将直播圣保罗大奖赛周五的练习赛，时间为下午3点30分和晚上7点
梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利已在上一站赢得世界冠军，乔治·拉塞尔回顾了自己这个艰难的赛季。
乔治·拉塞尔因使用全新梅赛德斯引擎，将在本周末圣保罗大奖赛被罚退后五位发车。
在马来西亚巴林大奖赛上，赛车故障导致他的车停下，因此人们一直预计这位英国车手会在赛季结束前再接受一次发车位罚退。
在上个月的新加坡大奖赛上，他使用了本赛季的第五台引擎以及其他动力单元部件，这让他在那里的发车位上跌到了队尾。
梅赛德斯如何能在本周日赢得车队总冠军

他现在将在英特拉格斯再次启用一台全新的内燃机，不过这一次只会触发五位罚退。因此，他在周日正赛的发车顺位最高只能是第六位。
梅赛德斯已确认，此次更换不涉及额外研发与升级机会（ADUO）元素，而这家领跑车队本赛季尚未引入其允许的一次升级。
拉塞尔在梅赛德斯Instagram Story的一段视频中确认了受罚消息，他说：“我的意思是，我们总归要在某个时候接受发车罚退。”
"显然我们在新加坡接受了一次，但从新加坡到赛季结束，我们觉得这里是接受处罚的好地方。"
马丁·布伦德尔认为，基米·安东内利赢得世界冠军可能会激发乔治·拉塞尔的“超速运转”，或者对这位梅赛德斯队友来说就是“游戏结束”。
"显然，刘易斯多年前[2021年]在这里遭遇了严重的发车位罚退，而且表现得相当不错。"
"五个位置似乎没那么糟，我们会努力追回来。"
英特拉格斯是一条有利于超车的赛道，因此这里顺理成章地成为接受发车位罚退的合理选择。本周末的比赛还可能受到降雨威胁。
拉塞尔的争冠挑战已于上周日在墨西哥正式结束，当时队友安东内利锁定了2026年的车手总冠军。本赛季还剩四场比赛，拉塞尔在积分榜上已滑落至第四位。

detailEn: George Russell: Mercedes driver to take five-place grid penalty at Sao Paulo GP for engine change
Watch Friday's practice sessions from the Sao Paulo Grand Prix at 3.30pm and 7pm live on Sky Sports F1
With Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli having won the world title at the last race, George Russell reflects on what's been a tough season for him.
George Russell will take a five-place grid penalty at this weekend's Sao Paulo Grand Prix for use of a fresh Mercedes engine.
The Briton was always expected to take an additional grid penalty before the end of the season after the failure that stopped his car at the Bahrain GP in Malaysia.
He took a fifth engine of the season, and other power unit parts, at last month's Singapore GP, which dropped him to the back of the field there.
How Mercedes can win Constructors' Championship this Sunday

He will now take another fresh internal combustion engine at Interlagos, although this time that only triggers a five-place demotion. He will therefore start Sunday's race no higher than sixth on Sunday's race grid.

Mercedes have confirmed there is no Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) element to the change, with the world championship leaders yet to introduce their one allowed upgrade this season.
Confirming the news of his penalty in a video on Mercedes' Instagram Story, Russell said: "I mean we always had to take a grid penalty at some point.
"Obviously we took one in Singapore but from Singapore until the end of the season, we felt this was a good place to take it.
Martin Brundle believes Kimi Antonelli winning the world title could trigger an 'overdrive' for George Russell, or it's 'game over' for the Mercedes team-mate.
"Obviously, Lewis had a big grid penalty here a number of years ago [2021] and did pretty well.
"Five places doesn't seem that bad and we'll try and come back through."
Interlagos is a circuit on which overtaking is favourable, making this venue a logical one to take a grid drop. Rain also threatens the race weekend.

Russell's championship challenge officially ended last Sunday in Mexico when team-mate Kimi Antonelli clinched 2026's drivers' title. Russell has slipped to fourth in the standings with four races to go this season.

items.originalTitle: McLaren's 2027 F1 front wing breaks cover in Brazil
detailZh: 迈凯轮在巴西大奖赛上揭幕了其2027年F1赛车的新前翼，这是车队为MCL40车型带来的最新升级。
作为车队在赛季末对MCL40车型进行持续改进的一部分，迈凯轮将最新的升级带到了Interlagos赛道。
这些升级包括对地板的调整、更新后的尾翼，以及将构成下赛季MCL41赛车起点的新前翼。
新前翼的设计对车队来说是一次概念上的转变，因为它在机翼各个元素上进行了许多修订。
主平面和端板的连接点已经修改，现在横跨下边缘——与经过优化的外板元素相接。
前翼和主平面之间的连接已经被调整，现在位于第二个襟翼上，而不是主平面上，同时新的机翼也在襟翼元素的高度上进行了调整。
在周末之前，麦凯轮车队解释说，这些改动旨在提供更多的下压力并改善车辆的平衡。
空气动力学首席技术官彼得·普罗多莫斯也明确表示，这些改动是2027年项目的起点。
“赛季还没有结束：这些升级是为了现在提高车辆性能，并帮助我们争夺年度第三名，”他解释道。
“我们从这些升级中学到的经验将用于下一年的车辆开发，同时我们也期待将新前翼的概念应用到下一款车型的首发规格中。”
detailEn: McLaren’s new front wing, which will be the same concept it launches its 2027 Formula 1 car with, has been revealed at the Brazilian Grand Prix.
As part of an end-of-season push by the Woking-based squad to deliver continuous improvements to its MCL40, the squad has brought its latest upgrades to Interlagos.
This includes tweaks to its floor, an updated rear wing, but also a front wing that will form the starting point for next season’s MCL41.
The front wing is a change of concept for the team as it features many revisions across the spectrum of wing elements.
The attachment point for the main plane and the endplate has been revised to now run across the lower edge – where it marries up with the refined outboard element.

The attachment between the nose and the main plane has been adjusted to sit on the second flap now rather than the mainplane, while the new wing also features an adjustment in the height of the flap elements.
Speaking ahead of the weekend, McLaren explained that the changes delivered were about both delivering more downforce and improving car balance.
Chief technical officer of aerodynamics Peter Prodromou also made clear that these changes were the launchpad for its 2027 project.
“The season isn't over yet: these upgrades are designed to improve the car now and help us in our fight for third in the championship,” he explained.

“While the learning we take from these upgrades will feed into next year’s development, we also expect to carry over the concept of the new front wing into the launch specification of next year’s car.”

detailZh: 塞恩斯回忆与勒克莱尔的较量：“我们总能找到解决办法”
这位威廉姆斯车手在谈及法拉利车手勒克莱尔在墨西哥与汉密尔顿的争夺时，回顾了自己与勒克莱尔的较量
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利车队，卡洛斯·塞恩斯，法拉利车队
塞恩斯表示，他与勒克莱尔在法拉利做队友时的轮对轮较量留下的是“美好回忆”，并谈到了他的前F1队友在墨西哥大奖赛与汉密尔顿的争夺。
在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道的首圈比赛中，法拉利车手之间为争夺领先展开了激烈较量，勒克莱尔在开局几个弯角向汉密尔顿发起进攻。这一连串攻防在勒克莱尔于4号弯尝试从队友外侧超车时结束，两位车手都冲出了赛道。
勒克莱尔最终排在汉密尔顿之前，而汉密尔顿还将一个位置丢给了马克斯·维斯塔潘。随后勒克莱尔被罚时五秒，这为红牛车手夺得胜利打开了大门。
汉密尔顿认同一种说法，即勒克莱尔在与他和前法拉利队友对抗时，比与其他对手较量时更拼，但塞恩斯认为这是在一级方程式（F1）中争夺胜利的自然结果。
“说实话，我对与夏尔共事的时光以及我们之间的较量有着相对美好的回忆，”这位西班牙车手在巴西说道。
确实，当你在为胜利而战时，压力总是更大，前方总有更多事情。所以你会自然而然地比在中游为第八或第九名而战时更自私一些。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利SF-24，卡洛斯·塞恩斯，法拉利SF-24
“所以也许更难完全遵循车队希望你遵循的理想情况，因为前方有胜利在望。”
汉密尔顿周四承认，他仍然对墨西哥发生的事情感到沮丧。回顾自己与勒克莱尔的较量，塞恩斯以蒙扎和拉斯维加斯为例，说明他们在赛道上的激烈争夺，但表示他们会在赛后交谈以解决任何分歧。
“那时候胜利就在眼前。但我觉得我一直尊重查尔斯。他也一直尊重我。我们从未有过接触之类的事情。我们只是有过激烈的争斗。我想你还记得蒙扎、拉斯维加斯。有很多火爆的时刻，”他说。
塞恩斯表示，更大的困难来自法拉利周围的压力，而不是他与勒克莱尔的关系，包括他说自己受到了一些勒克莱尔车迷的辱骂。
“我认为更困难的是车迷群体，更多是公关方面，当时车迷群体真的被点燃了。在查尔斯和我之间非常两极分化。我记得自己有点受到查尔斯那些非常铁杆车迷的困扰，他们辱骂我或诅咒我倒霉。
“也许一些意大利媒体也说，在我需要的时候，我不够像一个二号车手，反过来，每当查尔斯不得不这样做时也是如此。”
卡洛斯·塞恩斯，法拉利，夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利
“所以更多是围绕法拉利的压力牵涉到法拉利，而不是我与夏尔之间实际存在的问题，那些问题总是在当晚我们以更冷静的头脑互相通话时就解决了。我们总能找到向前推进的解决方案。”
塞恩斯表示，当两位有竞争力的车手争夺胜利时，队友之间的紧张关系不可避免，而且这种情况在一级方程式中并不新鲜。
“这种情况在一级方程式车队中一直存在，”他说。“我不记得有哪支一级方程式车队拥有两位优秀车手在前方争夺却从未在争胜时出现过问题。你可以选择让一位二号车手担任第二车手，也可以选择两位优秀车手，而他们会制造那些问题。但在我看来，你不能只要其一而不要其二，而且你永远不可能只要其一而不要其二。”
“我不知道，也许在法拉利，一切涉及法拉利的事情都会让情况变得有些激化，但我想不起有哪一刻没发生过这种事。梅赛德斯发生过，过去几年迈凯伦发生过，法拉利发生过，2006、2007、2008年迈凯伦也发生过。”
“所以我不知道什么时候没发生过。这是F1的一部分，如果你是车队领队，并且知道自己将拥有两位伟大的车手，你就总会遇到这个问题。我不认为你能让这两个人百分之百地平静下来，还指望他们不为分站冠军发起进攻。”

detailEn: Carlos Sainz recalls Charles Leclerc battles: “We always managed to find a solution”
The Williams driver reflected on his own battles with Charles Leclerc while discussing the Ferrari driver’s Mexico clash with Lewis Hamilton
Charles Leclerc, Scuderia Ferrari, Carlos Sainz, Scuderia Ferrari
Carlos Sainz says he has "good memories" of battling Charles Leclerc at Ferrari while offering his perspective on his former Formula 1 team-mate’s fight with Lewis Hamilton in the Mexican Grand Prix.

The Ferrari drivers had a fierce battle for the lead on the opening lap at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, with Leclerc attacking Hamilton through the opening corners. The sequence ended when Leclerc attempted to pass around the outside of his team-mate at Turn 4, with both drivers running off the track.
Leclerc emerged ahead of Hamilton, who also lost a position to Max Verstappen. The subsequent five-second penalty for the Monegasque opened the door for the Red Bull driver to take victory.
While Hamilton agreed with suggestions that Leclerc races him and former Ferrari team-mates harder than other rivals, Sainz viewed that as a natural consequence of fighting for victory in F1.
"Honestly, I have relatively good memories with my time with Charles and the fights we had," the Spaniard said in Brazil.

"It is true that when you're fighting for wins, there's always more pressure, more things down the line. So you become naturally a bit more selfish than when you are fighting in the midfield for a P8 or a P9.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari SF-24, Carlos Sainz, Ferrari SF-24
"So it's more difficult maybe to follow exactly the ideal situation that the team would like you to follow, because there's a win down the line."

Hamilton admitted on Thursday that he was "still frustrated" by what happened in Mexico. Reflecting on his own battles with Leclerc, Sainz cited Monza and Las Vegas as examples of their close on-track battles, but said they would speak afterwards to resolve any disagreement.

"There were wins on the line back then. But I think I always respected Charles. He always respected me. We never had contacts or anything like this. We just had strong fights. I think you remember Monza, Vegas. There were plenty of hot moments," he said.
Sainz said the greater difficulties came from the pressure surrounding Ferrari rather than his relationship with Leclerc, including abuse he said he received from some of Leclerc’s fans.

"I think what was difficult more was the fan base, more the PR and the fan base was really ignited back then. It was very polarised between Charles and me. I remember suffering a bit from the very hardcore fans of Charles, insulting or wishing me bad.
"Maybe some Italian media also saying that I was not being enough of a number two when I needed to be and vice versa whenever Charles had to do it."
Carlos Sainz, Ferrari, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari

"So it's more the pressure surrounding Ferrari that involves Ferrari than the actual issues that I had with Charles, which were always resolved that same night when we called each other in a more cold-head way. We always managed to find a solution on the way forward."
Sainz said tensions between team-mates are inevitable when two competitive drivers are fighting for victories, and that such situations are nothing new in F1.

"It's always been there in Formula 1 teams," he said. "I cannot remember a F1 team that has had two good drivers fighting at the front that haven't had issues when fighting for wins. You can choose whether to have a number two as a second driver or you can have two good drivers that will create those issues. But you cannot have one without the other, in my opinion, and you will never have one without the other."

"I don't know, maybe in Ferrari it gets a bit exacerbated with everything that involves Ferrari, but I cannot remember a moment where this hasn't happened. It happened in Mercedes, it happened in McLaren last few years, it happened in Ferrari, it happened in McLaren in 2006, 2007, 2008.

"So I don't know when it hasn't happened. It is part of Formula 1 and if you are a team principal and you know you are going to have two great drivers, you are always going to have that issue. I don't think you can ever calm those two guys 100% down and expect them not to go for a move for a race win."
